sequence.caption: The request arrives at web and is routed to the gateway.
The gateway forwards it to checkout, which orchestrates the rest.
Checkout asks inventory to reserve stock.
Inventory reserves the stock in db.
Checkout asks payments to charge the card.
Payments charges the card, then hands off to the queue asynchronously — checkout does not wait for this to land.
Checkout asks orders to record the order.
Orders writes the order to db.
Orders also enqueues an order-placed event, asynchronously.
Two hops run through the queue — the charge confirmation and the order event — both asynchronous.
These two async hops are what make checkout eventually — not immediately — consistent.
